preprocess_image_vae: preprocess a PIL image or tensor using VaeImageProcessor for VAE input with resize and normalization
postprocess_image_vae: postprocess a tensor output from VaeImageProcessor to PIL, numpy, or pytorch format
preprocess_inpaint_image: preprocess an image and mask pair using InpaintProcessor for inpainting pipeline input
preprocess_rgb_depth_ldm3d: preprocess RGB and depth image pairs using VaeImageProcessorLDM3D for 3D generation pipelines
downsample_ipadapter_mask: downsample a mask tensor using IPAdapterMaskProcessor for scaled dot-product attention compatibility
